database.missingEnvironment: Fails explicitly; no new ignored or silently skipped tests
database.ciRoute: Existing check.yml unit/binary and nextest lanes supply the guarded disposable database URL

contract.runtime: Both existing slash commands return a private, mention-safe, bounded reply through the actual CommandRuntime and real fenced store
contract.evidence: One and three unresolved rows are counted for only the selected guild/relay; fresh, expired and tokenless evidence count, settled and other relay/guild evidence do not
contract.presentation: Preserve stable relay ID; call the count a snapshot of unresolved delivery evidence, not failed or successful deliveries; explicitly state no lifecycle change occurred; wait for reconciliation and inspect via /feed-inspect
contract.privacy: No source URL, item key/body, nonce, claim/lease token or other relay/guild evidence; no channel POSTs or reconciliation triggered by the command
contract.preservation: An exact refusal leaves every relay, high-water and delivery-history column unchanged, including existing claim tokens, leases and timestamps; recovery_required audit outcomes remain
contract.bounds: A 2048-row ledger and maximum-length 128-character relay ID produce one summary within 2000 UTF-16 units; exact totals or explicit capped lower bounds are accepted
contract.fence: A claim observed queued ahead of the lifecycle operation is counted after admission, never from a pre-fence read; a settlement committed inside the fence wait is not reported as stale pending evidence
contract.controls: Zero/settled, missing/foreign, restored already-paused plus pending, and store-failure outcomes retain their existing state/audit semantics
contract.implementationOwnership: Builder supplies the two typed refusal outcomes, shared safe renderer, runtime integration and concise reference/runbook updates. Tests deliberately do not dictate private field names or source layout. No new recovery job, force operation or success timestamp.

handoff: Keep knowingly RED tests off main. Do not open or merge a test-only implementation PR.

Consume the immutable handoff SHA in an isolated Builder workspace and verify every protected SHA-256 before and after implementation. Never edit protected files; return oracle corrections to their author.

Expected baseline behavior is six assertion failures for missing evidence UX and four healthy controls. This is an expectation, not a claim of an observed run; actual results and CI links are recorded in the task handoff document.
Local cache refusal is not test RED and authorizes no direct Cargo, new target directory, cache cleanup or gate bypass.

Retain compatible recovery-required audit semantics and safe retry of the lifecycle operation only after reconciliation. Existing command/help registry counts do not change because no command is added.
Builder owns implementation GREEN, reference/runbook explanation, all review fixes, exact-head CI/review, auto-merge and delivery evidence in one combined PR.

Compatible existing pins are cited by name in existingPins and left unmodified at baseline. If the Builder design changes the shared refusal enum shape such that a cited pin no longer compiles, the Test Author issues a follow-up correction; the Builder never edits test files to fit.
